findings.observation: The medium-deep skin, compact facial outline, low brow, small nose, heavy lower lip, cheek mole, and core likeness remain recognizable, but enlarged round eyes, softened cheeks, and compressed facial planes make the subject read juvenile and generic rather than preserving the source’s mature 33-year-old adult identity.

The plus-size-heavy category remains obvious, but the conversion further inflates torso width, belly mass, shoulders, limbs, and overall softness beyond the already substantial natural mass of the source instead of preserving its relative widths.
Both arms and hands are visibly enlarged into thick generic chibi limbs and oversized closed fists relative to the source’s upper-arm, forearm, wrist, and hand proportions.
The violet-plum curls-and-coils halo preserves the shaved sides, front hairline, gathered mass, high silhouette, dense coil texture, and deliberately tousled construction of the summon.

The indigo-sand asymmetric patchwork layers, uneven frayed hems, visible repairs, contrasting inner edges, waist wraps, practical trousers, simple footwear, and tucked wooden comb remain source-faithful; no accessory or tattoo is added.

Original-resolution visual measurement places topmost hair near y=95, chin near y=654, and lowest sole near y=1440. The roughly 559 px head-and-hair unit occupies about 42% of the roughly 1345 px standing height, around 2.4 heads tall, above the required 32–36% / 2.75–3.1 range.
Exactly one subject appears with the entire coil halo and head, both hands, uneven garment hems, both feet, and grounding shadow fully inside generous parchment margins.
The grounded three-quarter stance, separated empty fists, broad silhouette, patchwork color blocks, and clear footwear read cleanly as a weaponless ready-idle at combat-icon scale.

The heavily repaired cloth, simple footwear, and wooden comb remain ordinary mortal elements with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, or watermark.
